title: Galangal Skewers with Jubilant Norwegian Glaze
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the spicy sweetness of galangal with the vibrant flavors of Norway. Perfect for a quick dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. Thread the galangal slices onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
3. Brush the skewers with a little bit of oil and season with salt and pepper.
4. Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
5. Meanwhile, mix the jubilant and norwegian ingredients in a small bowl.
6. Once the skewers are done, brush them with the jubilant and norwegian glaze.
8. Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
